instructions.instructions: Built-in maintainability lens; applies to every changed file. Apply the maintainability section of references/review-lenses.md as your checklist. Every finding here is a judgement call, never a hard violation: cap severity at medium — never report blocker or high from this lens. Stay strictly within the maintainability concern.
